title: Shift-loop sites
statement: A shift-loop site is one of three operations: multiply $K$ by $2^w$; multiply the endpoint stack $SE$ by $2^w$ to make room for a digit, with a Boolean parameter; or multiply $Q$ by $2^w$ to shift back the stack with its last digit removed, with a Boolean parameter.
hypotheses_covered: The shift-loop site is one of the three listed constructors
Boolean parameters are available on the two parameterized constructors
